item.text: I’ll inspect the test module and its surrounding context, then call out only concrete issues.

`test/orders.js` exports small shop-order helpers: calculate item totals, apply percentage discount codes, compute an average price, and format an order into line items plus a total.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length` ([line 5](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-k5Iuel/test/orders.js:5)). The final iteration accesses `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`, so `.price` throws for every array, including an empty one. It should use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` ([lines 20–21](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-k5Iuel/test/orders.js:20)) calculates total *quantity-weighted cost* but divides by the number of line items. For example, `2 × $10` returns `$20` as the “average item price,” rather than `$10`. It also returns `NaN`/`Infinity` behavior for an empty array.
- Consequently, `formatOrder` also throws when it calls `calcTotal` ([line 26](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-k5Iuel/test/orders.js:26)).
